title: Impellers / Blades (Rotational)
description: Complex 3D curved surfaces, thin-wall twisted blades, integral hub-blade structure
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) offers excellent specific strength (~230MPa/g·cm-3) and fatigue life (10^7 cycles >=500MPa). Industry standard for aero engine and compressor impellers.
Form: Die forging optimizes grain flow along blade contour, improving fatigue life by 30%+ vs bar milling, reducing waste by 90%.
comparisonNotes: Standards: Die forging, AMS 4928, Annealed, 100% FPI + UT Class A, Balance G2.5
